english: Shepherd, when was this little lamb born? He was born in the night; that white ewe brought him forth. Why is he crying? He is hungry; now he is sucking at her udder. Shall I lift him? Do not lift him on this day; his legs are weak. When he becomes strong, I will lead him to the pasture. Then you will be his shepherd.

english: Old man, I fell asleep, and the lambs ran off toward the hill. I am afraid of my father. Do not be afraid, boy; we shall find them. Lead the dog with you. Why shall I lead him? What the eyes do not see, the dog finds with its nose. I have caught sight of them! How many are there? There are four lambs. Then none is missing. Do not fall asleep in the field!

english: Grandfather, why are you scattering seed on the earth? The earth hides the seed, and it grows up. From the seed grain is born. Will we eat the grain? english: Of-True-Fame, how many fingers do I have? You have ten fingers. And how many horns does a goat have? A goat has two horns, and you have none! Then the goat is greater than I! The goat is not greater; he does not speak. Now show me your fingers! Here they are!

english: Grandmother, why do we pour milk for the gods? The gods give us cattle, and we give them milk. Fire carries it to them. Do they drink milk? They drink it, and they rejoice. Will you pour it with me at dawn? I will pour it with my two hands. The gods love the child who gives.

english: Old man, tell me a story of the fox. A fox found meat on the road, and a bear caught sight of her. The bear said: Give me the meat! And what did the fox say? english: Old man, sing me a song. I will praise Dawn, daughter of Sky. Dawn, shining one, bring us light! Why do you sing to her? She drives away the night, and the cattle wake up. Now sing it with me. Dawn, shining one, bring us light! You have come to know the song. Sing it to your sister.

english: Sister, who gave me my name? The old men set your name at the feast. Why did they choose it? You are Of-Good-Fame; may your fame be great! How shall I win fame? Speak true words, and protect the guest. I will speak true words. Then your fame will be imperishable.

english: Father, I found a nest in a tree, and in it there are three eggs. Shall I carry them home? Do not take them, son. Who laid them there? A bird laid them. The bird is seeking her eggs, and her heart is sad. Then I will leave them in the nest. In spring the young birds will fly. And I will watch them!
